description: JSON member-name safety. A receiver MUST refuse every text under "reject" BEFORE handing it to a JSON parser, and MUST accept every text under "accept". Each text is carried here as a string value; none appears as a member name.
rule: An object member name must not be written with an escape sequence.

reject.why: a member named with one reverse solidus
an escaped newline as a name
an escaped tab as a name
an escaped quotation mark as a name
an escaped solidus as a name
a control character written as a unicode escape
an ordinary letter written as a unicode escape
an escape inside a longer name
a second member, after a comma
a name after a nested array closes
a name after a nested object closes
text that is malformed after the unsafe name

accept.why: an array of escaped strings as a member value
a value that looks like an unsafe object
a value ending in an escaped reverse solidus
non-ASCII names, which need no escape
